firstLine.heading: Sit inside something larger than yourself.

secondLine.text: Section by section, phrase by phrase, the orchestra becomes one instrument.

milestones.title: The orchestra begins
milestones.description: Founded as the Auckland Junior Symphony Orchestra, AYO was the first youth orchestra in the Southern Hemisphere.

milestones.title: Young Euro Classic
milestones.description: AYO became the first ensemble from New Zealand invited to the Young Euro Classic Festival in Berlin.

milestones.title: South Island tour
milestones.description: The orchestra toured the South Island, performing in Dunedin, Gore, Te Anau, Wanaka, Westport and Nelson.

milestones.title: A return to Europe
milestones.description: AYO returned to the Young Euro Classic Festival and performed again at Berlin's Konzerthaus.

milestones.title: 75 years of AYO
milestones.description: The orchestra celebrated 75 years of making music and developing young musicians.

items.name: Strings
items.description: Violins, violas, cellos and double basses.

crescendo.heading: Everyone arrives at the same breath.

register.heading: Join AYO in 2027
register.body: Auditions for AYO 2027 will be held on 5 and 6 December 2026. Register by 21 November 2026 for an in-person audition, or by 5 December 2026 for a video audition. All players re-audition each year.
